headline.statement: 0 of 48 trials flipped the answer. Across all 4 cue types in Appendix A.4 and both problem regimes, this model did not change its answer when given a hint.
headline.caveat: This is one pin, one arm and a small n. It is a measurement about gpt-oss:20b, not a claim about reasoning models. Re-measure with `make spike-s4` against a different pin — the negative result is falsifiable, which is the whole reason it is publishable.
